top_signals.title: Goldman Sachs' Waldron Edges Closer to Top Job
top_signals.summary: The board of Goldman Sachs has discussed a plan for Chief Operating Officer John Waldron to succeed David Solomon as CEO as early as next year, according to the Wall Street Journal. With the latest plan, Waldron could take over toward the end of 2027 or in 2028, the Journal said. Bloomberg Opinion's Paul Davies breaks down the situation and its significance. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Philippines Starts Sale of Retail Bonds as Rates Stay High
top_signals.summary: The Philippines raised 84.9 billion pesos ($1.36 billion) in a retail Treasury bond auction, securing fresh funds for government spending while opting for a shorter tenor amid elevated interest rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Grant Thornton takes on Big Four giants with new £40K salary for London grads
